---
title: "Recipes"
---

Every page below runs its query **live**, in your browser, against the latest
release through DuckDB-WASM — no server renders these results. Each shows
the SQL it ran, so you can copy it straight into your own DuckDB.

::: {.callout-warning}
Large-table reads can fail intermittently in a long-lived browser tab — a
resource-accumulation limit in the pinned DuckDB-WASM build, not a bug in
any one query (tracked in
[cancer-basemap#120](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-basemap/issues/120)).
Each page's Retry button rebuilds its DuckDB-WASM instance from scratch,
which clears most failures; if Retry doesn't help, a **hard refresh**
(shift-reload) clears a cached failed response that a plain reload can
otherwise keep re-serving from the browser's own cache.
:::
